source.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־שָׂרְפ֛וֹ עַצְמ֥וֹת מֶֽלֶךְ־אֱד֖וֹם לַשִּֽׂיד׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: For three transgressions of Moab and for four, not I will turn it back, because he burned [the] bones of [the] king of Edom to lime.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q For three transgressions of Moab, \q and for four, I will not turn it back, \q because he burned the bones of the king of Edom to lime.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q For three crimes of Moab, \q even for four, I will not hold back the punishment, \q because he burned the bones of Edom's king to lime.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q The people of Moab have sinned again and again, \q so I will not hold back their punishment. \q They burned the bones of the king of Edom to ashes.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Por tres transgresiones de Moab, \q y por cuatro, no lo haré volver atrás, \q porque quemó los huesos del rey de Edom hasta reducirlos a cal.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q Por tres delitos de Moab, \q y aun por cuatro, no retendré el castigo, \q porque quemó los huesos del rey de Edom hasta convertirlos en cal.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q La gente de Moab ha pecado una y otra vez, \q así que no retendré su castigo. \q Quemaron los huesos del rey de Edom hasta convertirlos en ceniza.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Pour trois transgressions de Moab, \q et pour quatre, je ne le retirerai pas, \q parce qu’il a brûlé les os du roi d’Édom jusqu’à [en faire de] la chaux.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Pour trois crimes de Moab, \q et même pour quatre, je ne retiendrai pas le châtiment, \q parce qu’il a brûlé les os du roi d’Édom jusqu’à les réduire en chaux.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Les gens de Moab ont péché encore et encore, \q alors je ne retiendrai pas leur punition. \q Ils ont brûlé les os du roi d’Édom jusqu’à les réduire en cendres.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Kwa maasi matatu ya Moabu, \q naam, kwa manne, sitalirudisha nyuma, \q kwa sababu aliichoma mifupa ya mfalme wa Edomu kuwa chokaa.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Kwa makosa matatu ya Moabu, \q hata kwa manne, sitaizuia adhabu, \q kwa sababu aliichoma mifupa ya mfalme wa Edomu kuwa chokaa.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Watu wa Moabu wamefanya dhambi tena na tena, \q kwa hiyo sitaizuia adhabu yao. \q Waliichoma mifupa ya mfalme wa Edomu mpaka ikawa majivu.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Vì ba tội vi phạm của Mô-áp, \q và vì bốn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại điều ấy, \q vì nó đã thiêu xương của vua Ê-đôm thành vôi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q Vì ba tội ác của Mô-áp, \q phải, vì bốn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại hình phạt, \q vì nó đã thiêu xương vua Ê-đôm thành vôi.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Dân Mô-áp đã phạm tội hết lần này đến lần khác, \q nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại hình phạt dành cho chúng. \q Chúng đã thiêu xương của vua Ê-đôm thành tro.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 모압의 세 가지 반역과 \q 네 가지 [반역] 때문에 내가 그것을 되돌리지 않겠다. \q 그가 에돔 왕의 뼈를 불살라 석회로 만들었기 때문이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 모압이 지은 범죄가 셋, \q 아니 넷이나 되니 내가 그 벌을 거두지 않겠다. \q 그가 에돔 왕의 뼈를 불태워 석회로 만들었기 때문이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 모압 백성이 죄를 짓고 또 지었으니 \q 나는 그들에게 내릴 벌을 거두지 않겠다. \q 그들은 에돔 왕의 뼈를 불태워 재로 만들었다.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Por três transgressões de Moabe, \q e por quatro, não o revogarei, \q porque ele queimou os ossos do rei de Edom até [virarem] cal.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Por três transgressões de Moabe, \q e por quatro, não revogarei o castigo, \q porque ele queimou os ossos do rei de Edom até virarem cal.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: \q O povo de Moabe pecou vez após vez, \q por isso não vou deixar de castigá-lo. \q Eles queimaram os ossos do rei de Edom até virarem cinza.

decisions.choice: the refrain "for three transgressions ... and for four", as in 1:3
decisions.reason: The oracle opens with the same refrain as the others. On the number pattern and on the unnamed "it" in "I will not turn it back", see the notes at 1:3.

decisions.choice: Moab: the kingdom east of the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: Moab lay east of the Dead Sea, south of Ammon. Like Ammon it traced its descent to Lot (Genesis 19:37), and it was often at war with Israel and with Edom (2 Kings 3).

decisions.choice: burned the bones of the king of Edom to lime: an outrage against the dead
decisions.reason: To dig up and burn a man's bones denied him rest and dishonored him and his people (compare 2 Kings 23:16-20; Jeremiah 8:1-2). Burning them "to lime" means burning them down to a white powder like lime. The victim is Edom, not Israel: the LORD judges the crimes of the nations against each other, and against a people he has himself condemned (1:11). The event is not recorded anywhere else.

decisions.choice: to lime (L, B), to ashes (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "ashes" because lime as a powder is unfamiliar; the point is that nothing was left of the bones.

source.text: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־אֵ֣שׁ בְּמוֹאָ֔ב וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֣וֹת הַקְּרִיּ֑וֹת וּמֵ֤ת בְּשָׁאוֹן֙ מוֹאָ֔ב בִּתְרוּעָ֖ה בְּק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will send fire on Moab, and it will consume [the] fortresses of the Kerioth; and will die amid uproar Moab, with a war cry, with [the] sound of [a] trumpet.

en.L: So I will send fire on Moab, \q and it will consume the fortresses of Kerioth; \q and Moab will die amid uproar, \q with a war cry, with the sound of the trumpet.
en.B: So I will send fire on Moab, \q and it will devour the fortresses of Kerioth. \q Moab will die amid the uproar, \q amid war cries and the sound of the ram's horn.
en.R: So I will send fire on Moab, \q and it will burn up the fortresses of Kerioth. \q Moab will die in the noise of battle, \q as soldiers shout and trumpets blow.

es.L: Por eso enviaré fuego sobre Moab, \q y consumirá las fortalezas de Queriot; \q y Moab morirá en medio del estruendo, \q con gritos de guerra, con sonido de trompeta.
es.B: Por eso enviaré fuego sobre Moab, \q y devorará las fortalezas de Queriot. \q Moab morirá en medio del estruendo, \q entre gritos de guerra y el sonido del cuerno de carnero.
es.R: Por eso enviaré fuego sobre Moab, \q y quemará las fortalezas de Queriot. \q Moab morirá en medio del ruido de la batalla, \q mientras los soldados gritan y suenan las trompetas.

fr.L: Alors j’enverrai le feu sur Moab, \q et il consumera les forteresses de Qerioth ; \q et Moab mourra dans le tumulte, \q avec des cris de guerre, au son du cor.
fr.B: Alors j’enverrai le feu sur Moab, \q et il dévorera les forteresses de Qerioth. \q Moab mourra dans le tumulte, \q au milieu des cris de guerre et du son du cor.
fr.R: Alors j’enverrai le feu sur Moab, \q et il brûlera les forteresses de Qerioth. \q Moab mourra dans le bruit de la bataille, \q quand les soldats crieront et que les trompettes sonneront.

sw.L: Basi nitatuma moto juu ya Moabu, \q nao utaziteketeza ngome za Keriothi; \q na Moabu atakufa katikati ya ghasia, \q pamoja na kelele za vita, pamoja na sauti ya baragumu.
sw.B: Basi nitatuma moto juu ya Moabu, \q nao utazila ngome za Keriothi. \q Moabu atakufa katikati ya ghasia, \q katikati ya makelele ya vita na sauti ya baragumu.
sw.R: Basi nitatuma moto juu ya Moabu, \q nao utaziunguza ngome za Keriothi. \q Moabu atakufa katika kelele za vita, \q askari wakipiga kelele na baragumu zikilia.

vi.L: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai lửa xuống trên Mô-áp, \q và lửa sẽ thiêu nuốt các đồn lũy của Kê-ri-giốt; \q và Mô-áp sẽ chết giữa tiếng ồn ào, \q giữa tiếng hò hét, giữa tiếng kèn.
vi.B: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai lửa xuống trên Mô-áp, \q và lửa sẽ thiêu rụi các đồn lũy của Kê-ri-giốt. \q Mô-áp sẽ chết giữa cảnh hỗn loạn, \q giữa tiếng hò hét xung trận và tiếng tù và.
vi.R: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sai lửa xuống trên Mô-áp, \q và lửa sẽ đốt cháy các đồn lũy của Kê-ri-giốt. \q Mô-áp sẽ chết giữa tiếng ồn ào của chiến trận, \q khi binh lính hò hét và tiếng kèn vang lên.

ko.L: 그러므로 내가 모압에 불을 보내겠다. \q 그 불이 그리욧의 요새들을 사를 것이다. \q 모압은 소란 가운데서 죽을 것이다. \q 함성과 나팔 소리 가운데서 [죽을 것이다].
ko.B: 그러므로 내가 모압에 불을 보내겠다. \q 그 불이 그리욧의 요새들을 삼킬 것이다. \q 모압은 아우성 속에서 죽을 것이다. \q 함성과 숫양 뿔 나팔 소리 속에서 죽을 것이다.
ko.R: 그러므로 나는 모압에 불을 보내겠다. \q 그 불이 그리욧의 요새들을 태워 버릴 것이다. \q 모압은 전쟁의 소란 속에서 죽을 것이다. \q 군인들이 함성을 지르고 나팔이 울릴 때에 죽을 것이다.

pt.L: Por isso enviarei fogo sobre Moabe, \q e ele consumirá as fortalezas de Queriote; \q e Moabe morrerá no meio do tumulto, \q com grito de guerra, com o som do chifre de carneiro.
pt.B: Por isso enviarei fogo sobre Moabe, \q e ele devorará as fortalezas de Queriote. \q Moabe morrerá no meio do tumulto, \q entre gritos de guerra e o som do chifre de carneiro.
pt.R: Por isso vou mandar fogo sobre Moabe, \q e o fogo vai queimar as fortalezas de Queriote. \q Moabe vai morrer no barulho da batalha, \q enquanto os soldados gritam e as trombetas tocam.

decisions.choice: Kerioth: a town of Moab
decisions.reason: Kerioth is named among the towns of Moab in Jeremiah 48:24, 41. The inscription of Mesha, a king of Moab, mentions a shrine of the god Chemosh at a town of this name. Because the Hebrew has the article ("the Kerioth"), it could also be read as a common noun, "the towns", but a place name fits the pattern of the other oracles.

decisions.choice: Moab will die amid uproar: the nation falls as a man dies in battle
decisions.reason: Moab is spoken of as one person who is killed in the din of battle: the war cry of the attackers (1:14) and the horn that signals the attack.

decisions.choice: the trumpet (L), the ram's horn (B), trumpets (R)
decisions.reason: The word is the ram's horn, used to signal in war. The wording set for the prophets gives it as "trumpet" at Literal and Readable and "ram's horn" at Balanced (Jeremiah 4:5). Readable turns the phrases into a clause, "as soldiers shout and trumpets blow".

decisions.choice: "trompeta" (L, R); "cuerno de carnero" (B)
decisions.reason: The shofar as set at Joel 2:1; Queriot as Jeremiah 48:24 in Spanish.

decisions.choice: "cor" (L, B); "trompettes" (R) for the ram's horn, in the whole book
decisions.reason: The shofar is "cor" at Literal and Balanced and "trompette" at Readable in the French prophets.

decisions.choice: Queriote; o chifre de carneiro (L, B), as trombetas (R)
decisions.reason: The town (m1) takes the form Jeremiah 48:24 and 48:41 give it in Portuguese. For the whole book (also 3:6), the ram's horn is "chifre de carneiro" at Literal and Balanced, the Portuguese the Old Testament gives the shofar (Exodus 19:13; Jeremiah 4:5), and "trombeta" at Readable, where the English Readable says "trumpet".

source.text: וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י שׁוֹפֵ֖ט מִקִּרְבָּ֑הּ וְכָל־שָׂרֶ֛יהָ אֶהֱר֥וֹג עִמּ֖וֹ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And I will cut off [the] judge from its midst, and all its officials I will kill with him, says Yahweh.

en.L: And I will cut off the judge from its midst, \q and all its officials I will kill with him, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will cut off the ruler from among its people \q and kill all its officials with him, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will remove Moab's ruler \q and kill all its leaders along with him, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y cortaré al juez de en medio de ella, \q y mataré con él a todos sus príncipes, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Eliminaré al gobernante de en medio de su pueblo \q y mataré con él a todos sus jefes, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Quitaré al gobernante de Moab \q y mataré junto con él a todos sus dirigentes, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et je retrancherai le juge du milieu d’elle, \q et tous ses chefs, je [les] tuerai avec lui, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je retrancherai du milieu de son peuple celui qui gouverne, \q et je tuerai avec lui tous ses chefs, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je ferai disparaître celui qui gouverne Moab, \q et je tuerai tous ses dirigeants avec lui, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitamkatilia mbali mwamuzi kutoka katikati yake, \q na maafisa wake wote nitawaua pamoja naye, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitamkatilia mbali mtawala kutoka kati ya watu wake \q na kuwaua maafisa wake wote pamoja naye, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitamwondoa mtawala wa Moabu \q na kuwaua viongozi wake wote pamoja naye, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ diệt trừ quan xét khỏi giữa nó, \q và mọi quan chức của nó {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giết cùng với người, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.B: Ta sẽ diệt trừ kẻ cai trị khỏi giữa dân nó \q và giết mọi quan chức của nó cùng với người, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.R: Ta sẽ loại bỏ kẻ cai trị Mô-áp \q và giết mọi người lãnh đạo của nó cùng với người, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 내가 그 가운데서 재판관을 끊어 버리고, \q 그와 함께 그의 모든 고관을 죽이겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.B: 내가 그 백성 가운데서 통치자를 없애고 \q 그와 함께 모든 관리를 죽이겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 나는 모압의 통치자를 없애고 \q 그와 함께 모든 지도자를 죽이겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: E eliminarei o juiz do meio dela, \q e todos os seus oficiais matarei com ele, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Eliminarei o governante do meio do seu povo \q e matarei com ele todos os seus oficiais, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Vou tirar o governante de Moabe \q e matar todos os seus líderes junto com ele, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: the judge: the ruler of Moab
decisions.reason: "Judge" here means the one who governs, as the word is used of rulers in general (Hosea 7:7; 13:10). When King Uzziah of Judah fell ill, his son Jotham "judged the people of the land" (2 Kings 15:5). So the judge may be the king or one who ruled in his place.

decisions.choice: its midst ... its officials: the land of Moab
decisions.reason: The pronoun "its" is feminine, so it refers to the land of Moab, which in Hebrew is feminine, not to Moab as "he" in verses 1-2.

decisions.choice: the judge (L), the ruler (B), Moab's ruler (R); officials (L, B), leaders (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "ruler" (m1), and Readable names Moab. "Officials" and "leaders" are the settled wording for this word.

decisions.choice: do meio dela; os seus oficiais
decisions.reason: The pronoun is feminine and refers to the land of Moab (m2); Portuguese "dela" keeps that, since "terra" is feminine too, where "dele" would point back to Moab the man of verses 1-2.

source.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַֽל־מָאֳסָ֞ם אֶת־תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה וְחֻקָּיו֙ לֹ֣א שָׁמָ֔רוּ וַיַּתְעוּם֙ כִּזְבֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הָלְכ֥וּ אֲבוֹתָ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: For three transgressions of Judah and for four, not I will turn it back, because they rejected [the] instruction of Yahweh, and his statutes not they kept, and led them astray their lies, after which walked their fathers.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q For three transgressions of Judah, \q and for four, I will not turn it back, \q because they rejected the instruction of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and did not keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes, \q and their lies led them astray, \q [the lies] after which their fathers walked.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q For three crimes of Judah, \q even for four, I will not hold back the punishment, \q because they rejected the instruction of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and did not keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes; \q their lies have led them astray, \q the lies their ancestors followed.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q The people of Judah have sinned again and again, \q so I will not hold back their punishment. \q They rejected the teaching of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and did not obey {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws. \q They were led astray by false gods, \q the same lies their ancestors followed.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Por tres transgresiones de Judá, \q y por cuatro, no lo haré volver atrás, \q porque rechazaron la instrucción {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y no guardaron {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos, \q y los extraviaron sus mentiras, \q [las mentiras] tras las cuales anduvieron sus padres.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q Por tres delitos de Judá, \q y aun por cuatro, no retendré el castigo, \q porque rechazaron la instrucción {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y no guardaron {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos; \q sus mentiras los han extraviado, \q las mismas mentiras que siguieron sus antepasados.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q La gente de Judá ha pecado una y otra vez, \q así que no retendré su castigo. \q Rechazaron la enseñanza {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y no obedecieron {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes. \q Los dioses falsos los llevaron por mal camino, \q las mismas mentiras que siguieron sus antepasados.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Pour trois transgressions de Juda, \q et pour quatre, je ne le retirerai pas, \q parce qu’ils ont rejeté la loi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et n’ont pas gardé {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions, \q et leurs mensonges les ont égarés, \q [ceux] derrière lesquels leurs pères ont marché.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Pour trois crimes de Juda, \q et même pour quatre, je ne retiendrai pas le châtiment, \q parce qu’ils ont rejeté l’instruction {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et n’ont pas gardé {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions ; \q leurs mensonges les ont égarés, \q les mensonges que leurs ancêtres ont suivis.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Les gens de Juda ont péché encore et encore, \q alors je ne retiendrai pas leur punition. \q Ils ont rejeté l’enseignement {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et n’ont pas obéi à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois. \q Ils se sont laissé égarer par de faux dieux, \q les mêmes mensonges que leurs ancêtres avaient suivis.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Kwa maasi matatu ya Yuda, \q naam, kwa manne, sitalirudisha nyuma, \q kwa sababu wameikataa sheria ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wala hawakuzishika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, \q na uongo wao umewapotosha, \q [uongo] ambao baba zao waliufuata.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Kwa makosa matatu ya Yuda, \q hata kwa manne, sitaizuia adhabu, \q kwa sababu waliyakataa mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wala hawakuzishika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}; \q uongo wao umewapotosha, \q uongo ule ambao babu zao waliufuata.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Watu wa Yuda wamefanya dhambi tena na tena, \q kwa hiyo sitaizuia adhabu yao. \q Waliyakataa mafundisho ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wala hawakuzitii sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. \q Walipotoshwa na miungu ya uongo, \q uongo ule ule ambao babu zao waliufuata.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Vì ba tội vi phạm của Giu-đa, \q và vì bốn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại điều ấy, \q vì chúng đã khước từ luật pháp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và không giữ các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và những điều dối trá của chúng đã làm chúng lầm lạc, \q [những điều dối trá] mà tổ phụ chúng đã đi theo.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q Vì ba tội ác của Giu-đa, \q phải, vì bốn, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại hình phạt, \q vì chúng đã khước từ luật pháp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và không giữ các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q những điều dối trá đã làm chúng lầm lạc, \q là những điều dối trá mà tổ tiên chúng đã theo.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Dân Giu-đa đã phạm tội hết lần này đến lần khác, \q nên {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại hình phạt dành cho chúng. \q Chúng đã khước từ lời dạy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và không vâng giữ các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Các thần giả đã làm chúng lầm lạc, \q cũng là những điều dối trá mà tổ tiên chúng đã theo.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 유다의 세 가지 반역과 \q 네 가지 [반역] 때문에 내가 그것을 되돌리지 않겠다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침을 버리고 그의 규례들을 지키지 않았으며, \q 그들의 거짓 [신들이] 그들을 그릇된 길로 이끌었기 때문이다. \q 그들의 조상들이 따라다니던 [거짓 신들이다].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 유다가 지은 범죄가 셋, \q 아니 넷이나 되니 내가 그 벌을 거두지 않겠다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침을 버리고 그의 규례를 지키지 않았기 때문이다. \q 그들의 거짓 신들이 그들을 그릇된 길로 이끌었다. \q 그들의 조상들도 따라다니던 거짓 신들이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 유다 백성이 죄를 짓고 또 지었으니 \q 나는 그들에게 내릴 벌을 거두지 않겠다. \q 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 가르침을 거절하고 그의 법을 지키지 않았다. \q 그들은 거짓 신들에게 속아 그릇된 길로 갔다. \q 그들의 조상들도 그 거짓 신들을 따랐다.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Por três transgressões de Judá, \q e por quatro, não o revogarei, \q porque rejeitaram a instrução {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e não guardaram os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} estatutos, \q e as suas mentiras os desviaram, \q [as mentiras] atrás das quais andaram os seus pais.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Por três transgressões de Judá, \q e por quatro, não revogarei o castigo, \q porque rejeitaram a instrução {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e não guardaram os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} estatutos; \q as suas mentiras os desviaram, \q as mesmas mentiras que os seus antepassados seguiram.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: \q O povo de Judá pecou vez após vez, \q por isso não vou deixar de castigá-lo. \q Eles rejeitaram o ensino {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e não obedeceram às {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} leis. \q Eles se deixaram enganar por deuses falsos, \q as mesmas mentiras que os seus antepassados seguiram.

decisions.choice: the refrain "for three transgressions ... and for four", as in 1:3
decisions.reason: The oracle opens with the same refrain as the others. On the number pattern and on the unnamed "it" in "I will not turn it back", see the notes at 1:3. Judah, Amos's own country, is now added to the list of nations.

decisions.choice: rejected the instruction of the LORD and did not keep his statutes: Judah's crime is against the covenant
decisions.reason: The nations were charged with cruelty to other peoples; Judah is charged with rejecting what the LORD taught it. "Instruction" is the word often translated "law": the LORD's teaching given to his people (Hosea 4:6; 8:1). "Statutes" are his fixed decrees. The wording is close to that of Deuteronomy and of 2 Kings 17:15, which says that Israel "rejected his statutes and his covenant ... and went after worthless things".

decisions.choice: their lies: false gods, and the worship of them
decisions.reason: "Lies" most likely means the false gods that Judah worshiped, which are "lies" because they are not gods and fail those who trust them (Psalm 40:5; Jeremiah 16:19-20; compare 2 Kings 17:15). Some take the word as the lies of false prophets who misled the people (Micah 2:11; Ezekiel 13:6-9).

decisions.choice: after which their fathers walked: the sin is an old one, handed down
decisions.reason: To "walk after" a god is to follow and worship it (Deuteronomy 8:19; Jeremiah 9:13). The fathers are the earlier generations: Judah's turning from the LORD is not new (Jeremiah 16:11-12).

decisions.choice: instruction (L, B), teaching (R); statutes (L, B), laws (R); false gods (R); fathers (L), ancestors (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Instruction" and "teaching" are the settled wording for this word. Readable says "false gods" for "lies" (m3), and so takes a side the Hebrew leaves open; it keeps "lies" in the last line.

decisions.choice: "instrucción" (L, B), "enseñanza" (R); "estatutos" (L, B), "leyes" (R); "padres" (L), "antepasados" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Torah and huqqim as the Spanish terms notes set for the prophets.

decisions.choice: "la loi" (L), "l'instruction" (B), "l'enseignement" (R) for torah; "prescriptions" (L, B), "lois" (R) for the statutes
decisions.reason: God's torah is worded as in the French prophets; the capital "la Loi" is kept for the Law of Moses named as such.

decisions.choice: "sheria" (L), "mafundisho" (B, R) for torah; "kanuni" (L, B), "sheria" (R) for the statutes, as the Pentateuch
decisions.reason: As the Psalms and Isaiah notes: torah is the LORD's instruction for how to live, so Balanced and Readable say "mafundisho"; Literal keeps the familiar "sheria".

decisions.choice: "luật pháp của CHÚA" (L, B), "lời dạy của CHÚA" (R); "luật lệ" (every level)
decisions.reason: Torah follows Isaiah 5:24 ("luật pháp của CHÚA"); Readable says "lời dạy", as the English Readable says "teaching". Statutes (chuqqim) are "luật lệ", as the Pentateuch note.

decisions.choice: *Torah* is "가르침" at every level; *chuqqim* "규례" (L, B), "법" (R); God names himself "그의" without -시- inside his own speech
decisions.reason: As Isaiah (5:24) and Jeremiah: "가르침" for the instruction of the prophets, with "율법" kept for the law code. The oracle is God's speech, so the third-person reference to him takes no honorific.

decisions.choice: "그들의 거짓 [신들이]" (L); "거짓 신들" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Korean "거짓" alone would read as lying words; the meaning decision says the lies are false gods, which Literal brackets.

decisions.choice: a instrução (L, B), o ensino (R); os estatutos (L, B), as leis (R)
decisions.reason: The word often rendered "law" (m2) follows the English levels: "instrução" at Literal and Balanced, "ensino" at Readable; "estatutos", as the Old Testament terms set it.

pt.R: Por isso vou mandar fogo sobre Judá, \q e o fogo vai queimar as fortalezas de Jerusalém.

decisions.choice: send fire on Judah ... the fortresses of Jerusalem: Judah receives the same sentence as the nations
decisions.reason: Judah is punished with the same words as Damascus, Gaza and the others (1:4). Being the LORD's people does not exempt it. When the Babylonians took Jerusalem in 586 BC they burned its great houses (2 Kings 25:9).

source.text: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־מִכְרָ֤ם בַּכֶּ֨סֶף֙ צַדִּ֔יק וְאֶבְי֖וֹן בַּעֲב֥וּר נַעֲלָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: For three transgressions of Israel and for four, not I will turn it back, because they sell for silver [the] righteous, and [the] needy for [the] sake of a pair of sandals.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q For three transgressions of Israel, \q and for four, I will not turn it back, \q because they sell the righteous for silver, \q and the needy for the sake of a pair of sandals.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q For three crimes of Israel, \q even for four, I will not hold back the punishment, \q because they sell the innocent for silver \q and the needy for a pair of sandals.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q The people of Israel have sinned again and again, \q so I will not hold back their punishment. \q They sell honest people for money \q and poor people for the price of a pair of sandals.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Por tres transgresiones de Israel, \q y por cuatro, no lo haré volver atrás, \q porque venden al justo por plata, \q y al necesitado por un par de sandalias.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q Por tres delitos de Israel, \q y aun por cuatro, no retendré el castigo, \q porque venden al inocente por plata \q y al necesitado por un par de sandalias.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q La gente de Israel ha pecado una y otra vez, \q así que no retendré su castigo. \q Venden a la gente honrada por dinero \q y a los pobres por lo que cuesta un par de sandalias.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Pour trois transgressions d’Israël, \q et pour quatre, je ne le retirerai pas, \q parce qu’ils vendent le juste pour de l’argent, \q et le pauvre pour une paire de sandales.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Pour trois crimes d’Israël, \q et même pour quatre, je ne retiendrai pas le châtiment, \q parce qu’ils vendent l’innocent pour de l’argent \q et le pauvre pour une paire de sandales.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Les gens d’Israël ont péché encore et encore, \q alors je ne retiendrai pas leur punition. \q Ils vendent des gens honnêtes pour de l’argent \q et des pauvres pour le prix d’une paire de sandales.
